acceptance: A ratchet fails CI when a function grows past 50 lines or a new function exceeds it; existing offenders are listed and may only shrink.
priority_rationale: inbox review 2026-09-27: the 50-line limit is enforced only in packages that pin their own limits
summary: A bugfix cycle (1720) left ship/consume.go's consumeCommittedItems at ~110 lines and stage at ~99; only packages that pin their own limits test enforce the rule. Design doc §7.9 G2. The ratchet lives in its own package (go/internal/sizeratchet: a test that walks the module with go/ast, plus a checked-in offender list that may only shrink), so the lane shares no surface with other work; go/acs/regression is a protected surface a lane cannot write.
title: The 50-line function limit is one repo-wide ratchet, not a test in a few packages
